name: BeeFlix Profiles
description: Private member profiles using existing Jellyfin Enhanced reviews and ratings.

versions.changelog: PREVIEW: Adds unlockable member rewards, equipped profile titles, reward badges, profile identity links, and optional Jellyfin Enhanced review integration. Catalog version is numeric for Jellyfin compatibility; the GitHub release is a preview. Requires Jellyfin 12 (ABI 12.0.0.0). Back up the existing plugin and configuration before upgrading; live testing is still required.
